features.name: Burke Lake Marina
features.description: The main lakefront recreation hub provides seasonal rowboat and canoe rentals, bait and tackle, a county boat launch, trail access, parking, and the starting point for the 4.68-mile lake loop.

details.positionQuality: Official marina address and park map cross-checked against the public mapped Burke Lake Marina location
details.imageAlt: Burke Lake Marina at Burke Lake Park

features.name: Burke Lake Railroad
features.description: A one-third-scale C.P. Huntington miniature steam-engine replica pulls passengers on a roughly 1.75-mile, ten-minute circuit through the park.

details.positionQuality: Official park map and attraction page cross-checked against the public mapped Burke Lake Railroad location
details.imageAlt: Burke Lake Railroad at Burke Lake Park

features.name: Burke Lake Dam & State Boat Launch
features.description: A separate dam crossing and state-owned 24-hour boat launch provide lake views, trail continuity, and early access for properly equipped anglers outside the main marina complex.
